zh: 删掉 AWS 后左右拼接，拼接处可能形成新的 AWS，所以只扫一遍找子串是不够的；但新形成的 AWS 一定以刚处理到的字符结尾。
用栈模拟：逐个字符入栈，每次入栈后检查栈顶三个字符是否依次为 A、W、S，是就一起弹出。
遍历字符串并压入当前字符；若栈长度至少为 3 且末尾三个字符依次是 A、W、S，就删除这三个；最后把栈拼成字符串输出，为空时输出 −1。
en: After deleting AWS the two sides are joined, and a new AWS may form at the seam, so a single substring scan is not enough; but any newly formed AWS must end at the character just processed.
Simulate with a stack: push characters one by one and, after each push, check whether the top three characters are A, W, S in order; if so, pop all three.
Walk through the string pushing each character; whenever the stack has at least 3 characters ending in A, W, S, remove those three; finally print the stack as a string, or −1 if it is empty.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Push characters onto a stack one by one, and whenever the stack ends with AWS, delete those three characters.

## Proof of correctness

After a prefix is processed, the stack contains no AWS; appending one character can only form AWS at the new suffix, and after it is deleted the rest already had no match. AWS has no non-empty proper prefix equal to a suffix, so two deletable matches never overlap and the order of deletions can be swapped; the terminating process has a unique result, and the stack produces it.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(n) space.
